articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Kinematic Model Predictions and Real Data for 6-DOF Robot KUKA KR4R600
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This paper presents a comparative analysis of kinematic model predictions for a 6-DOF KUKA KR4 R600 robot with real measurements of intermediate points (x, y, z) in order to evaluate the accuracy and reliability of the kinematic model under real-world conditions. The kinematic model, which is a fundamental tool in robotics, is used to calculate the position and orientation of the robot end effectors based on joint angles. The results of this analysis can provide valuable insights into potential sources of error and limitations of the kinematic model, as well as provide a basis for future improvements in robot calibration and control.

articleTitle: Construction and Analysis of a Model for Servicing Voice Requests and Files in Modern Contact Centers
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article presents a mathematical model of joint service of voice requests and requests in the form of files in a contact center. The model takes into account the features of modern request processing systems: group receipt of files, the possibility of waiting for them taking into account the aging of information, pre-processing of voice requests by robotic operators. We have developed a recursive algorithm for evaluating the main characteristics of the system's quality of operation, including the probability of loss of various types of requests, operator loading, and average file waiting time. The numerical analysis carried out showed a significant impact of the group nature of file receipt on service indicators: with the same load, file losses exceed the loss of voice requests, which requires an increase in the number of operators by 30-40%. The effect of prioritizing file maintenance when using the wait buffer is investigated. The results obtained can be applied to optimize the infrastructure of contact centers and improve the quality of service with limited resources.

articleTitle: Protocol Development for Efficient Data Routing in a Terrestrial Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Wireless sensor networks (WSN) play a key role in a variety of applications including environmental monitoring, precision agriculture, and industrial automation. Efficient data routing in WSN is crucial for optimizing energy consumption, extending network lifetime, and ensuring reliable communication, but remains a critical issue in wireless sensor networks due to their resource constraints. This paper proposes a novel routing protocol, KmHNNSP (K-means Hopfield Neural Network for Shortest Path), which combines a K-means clustering algorithm and a shortest path algorithm for energy-efficient data transmission using a Hopfield neural network. Simulation results are presented to compare the performance of KmHNNSP with LEACH and improved LEACH (ILEACH) protocols and show that KmHNNSP significantly outperforms both protocols in terms of network lifetime and energy consumption.

articleTitle: Effective Estimation of Motion Parameters of Mobile Robotic Complexes Based on Information Processing of Technical Vision Systems
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The accuracy of positioning and determining the spatial orientation of mobile robotic systems (MRS) that monitor traffic conditions, urban infrastructure, assess emergency situations and their consequences, etc., directly depends on the efficiency of processing information received from machine vision systems (MVS). Some of the most effective methods for assessing the navigation parameters of MRS using MVS are methods based on calculating the velocity field of the optical flow reflected from the surface. At the same time, direct calculation of the velocity field is a very complex computational task. In the practical use of existing methods for processing optical flow based on various assumptions, the computational costs are often unrealizable for on-board computers, which makes it impossible to solve the navigation problem in real time. Due to the relevance of this problem, the article considers one of the possible options for its solution, based on solving a system of linear equations and providing minimal computational costs when determining the linear and angular velocities of MRS, easily implemented in the on-board computer in real time. A natural experiment was conducted to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Research and Development of Kubernetes Operator for Lightweight Multi-Access Edge Computing Platform Simulator
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This paper addresses the problem of deploying complex systems in Kubernetes clusters. It discusses using the OperatorSDK framework supported by RedHat as a basis for implementing the Kubernetes operator for Lightweight MultiAccess Edge Computing Platform Simulator (LWMECPS) deployment. Special attention is given to the operator Kubernetes architecture and how to use Operator Lifecycle Manager (OLM) to continuously deploy LWMECPS and machine learning models for it.

articleTitle: Analytical Methods of Multicriterial Optimization in Logistic Transport Systems
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article presents methods of multicriterial optimization, which are of the greatest interest in the complex control systems synthesis, such as logistic transport systems (LTS). Complex systems synthesis involves the design of derivative structures optimized by a vector criteria. The main multicriterial optimization theory postulate is the position on the unattainability in the general case of exact optimization of the vector functional, which gives rise to a variety of methods and models for solving multicriterial optimization problems. In this regard, it is necessary to generalize the most common formal approaches to the problem of optimization by vector criteria.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Algorithms Based on Variations of the Least Squares Method for Power Amplifier Distortion Compensation
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Variants of indirect learning based on the Least Squares Method (LSM) and the Recursive Least Squares Method (RLSM) are considered for digital predistortion of nonlinear distortions in complex composite signals with high peak-toaverage power ratios in power amplifiers. The advantage of the recursive algorithm is identified, providing approximately 9 dB lower levels of spurious out-of-band emissions for the amplified complex signal compared to the simple least squares algorithm. It is shown that for the polynomial model of the power amplifier used in the study, the recursive algorithm requires approximately 700 times more elementary mathematical operations to achieve the most efficient compensation of signal nonlinearities than the least squares algorithm.

articleTitle: On Improving the Efficiency of the Technical Vision System of the Robotics Complex
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: One of the most important elements of the groundbased robotic complex is the vision system. Taking into account the requirements for increasing the autonomy of robotic complexes, an important function of a robotic complex is the detection and recognition of objects in the field of view. The article is devoted to solving the problem of increasing the efficiency of object recognition by the vision system due to the integration of heterogeneous information: optical and radar images. A convolutional neural network was used as a recognition device. It is shown that the integration of information makes it possible to increase the efficiency of the technical vision system of the robotic complex by 38-43%.

articleTitle: Analysis of Software Necessary Possibilities and Development for Scientific Assessment Process Automation and Students Creative Potential as a Factor in Increasing the Educational Process Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The application of information technologies to the process of evaluating the scientific and creative potential of students opens up new prospects and wide opportunities to increase the effectiveness of the educational process. The use of the developed software allows not only to evaluate the scientific and creative potential, but also the leadership qualities of students, which in turn will allow teaching staff to increase students' interest in the academic discipline, as well as develop their abilities to successfully master other academic disciplines.

articleTitle: Development of an Effective Method for Detecting Abnormal Situations in Transport Based on Driver Speech Analysis
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper considers the main applications of audio analysis in transportation. Machine learning techniques for the task of audio analysis, such as automatic speech recognition and keyword spotting, have been compared for the task of the driver speech analysis. The main causes of accidents in automobiles have been considered. Using a specially collected dataset, a keyword spotting model has been trained to find keywords related to abnormal situations in the vehicle in the audio stream. An evaluation of the quality and efficiency of the developed model was performed. Based on the obtained data, the main research directions in the field of driver assistance systems using machine learning audio analysis methods were identified.

articleTitle: Broadcast Content Distribution in 5G Mobile Networks Integrated with Satellites
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article analyzes the role of satellite communications in the ecosystem of fifth-generation networks and the prospects for its development. The key features of 5G technology, the limitations of terrestrial networks, and the benefits of satellite integration for global coverage, resiliency, and mobility support are discussed. Special attention is paid to technical and economic challenges, such as signal delay, power consumption, standardization and launch costs, and modern solutions are proposed, including protocol optimization, the use of artificial intelligence and the development of reusable rockets. The prospects of satellite communications are discussed, including mass connection of subscribers ‘ devices, improvement of communication in remote regions, and support for missioncritical applications. It is shown that the integration of satellites into the 5G ecosystem will be a key factor for creating a global, reliable and high-speed communication network that can meet the growing needs of the digital society.

articleTitle: A Study of Closed-Form and Iterative Methods for Solving Multilateration Problem
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article explores and compares different methods for solving the multilateration problem, focusing on closed-form and iterative approaches. Using implementations in C++ with the Eigen library, the study highlights how one closed-form solution surpasses gradient descent in both accuracy and speed-challenging traditional assumptions about the limitations of such methods. The analysis covers a wide range of techniques, evaluating their performance under various conditions, including noise levels and beacon configurations. The findings offer practical insights into the trade-offs between complexity, stability, and precision, helping readers choose the best method for applications like mobile positioning, navigation, and sensor networks.

articleTitle: Modeling of Blockchain Systems in Internet of Things Networks
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Blockchain technologies, due to their properties of decentralization, data immutability and cryptographic security, offer a promising solution for IoT networks. However, storing data in a blockchain may not always meet real-time requirements. When designing IoT networks that use blockchain for data storage, it is necessary to evaluate the probabilistic and temporal characteristics of the blockchain, such as the time of block formation and transaction confirmation. The paper proposes a queuing model for a blockchain network with the Proof of Work consensus algorithm. It is modeled as a closed queuing network with a complex dialogue structure between participants. The model could be used to design a blockchain for IoT systems that accounts for network characteristics and blockchain operation parameters.

articleTitle: Analysis and Evaluation of the Effectiveness of Data Center Creation Projects Taking into Account Real Options
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article presents an approach to assessing data center (DPC) projects based on the real options concept. These projects are characterized by a high degree of uncertainty, long commissioning periods, and the need for ongoing management. The authors demonstrate the feasibility of using this approach. They show that its application allows for more effective analysis and assessment of the economic efficiency of such projects. The article presents the methodology and results of calculating the economic efficiency of a DPC project using the real options method. The use of real options allows companies to reduce risks, increase revenues, and optimize costs when implementing DPC projects. The presented calculation methodology, based on the Black-Scholes model, allows for assessing the increase in profit and cash flow with additional investment in the project. The article also describes the Hurwitz method, which is used together with the real options concept. This allows for substantiating decisions made under uncertainty. The authors presents the results of calculating the economic efficiency of a DPC project using the Hurwitz method and the real options concept. These results confirm the feasibility of using this approach to analyze and evaluate such projects.

articleTitle: Analyzing Integrated Solutions for Monitoring and Management of Infocommunication Networks and IT Assets
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article considers various solutions of tools for monitoring and management of communication network and IT assets. Of the three approaches to a monitoring system, the solution with tight integration of its constituent elements is the most fully considered. The description of the main functions of the system is presented, such as collection, processing and visualisation of traffic data, control and configuration of equipment. The architecture of this system is analysed and the main advantages of monitoring integration into the communication network are revealed. The metrological component of such tools, providing accuracy and reliability of parameters of analysed data, control of equipment technical characteristics and compliance with regulatory requirements, is considered separately.

articleTitle: Conducting Competitions in Building Fiber-Optic Cable Networks Among Students of a Technical University
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article describes the plan for holding one of the modules of the competition on building cable and fiber-optic networks by students of a technical university studying in communications specialties. The plan is written in accordance with the exchange experience with Tianjin Electronic Information College in the context of interaction in the Luban workshop.

articleTitle: Development of a Method for Assessing Indicators of Discrete Control Systems
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In modern industry and transport systems, control to ensure the accuracy of technology processes is of crucial significance. The article provides examples of using the theory of dynamic systems to ensure the accuracy of control systems for elements of transport systems, allowing for monitoring, optimization and intensification of processes based on automated systems for analyzing control system indicators. Control systems encounter such disturbing factors as dynamic loads, equipment wear and tear and external factors leading to variations from specified parameters. The paper presents studies of dynamic characteristics to determine potential opportunities for adjusting process parameters, which in turn help in identifying the causes of deviations and determining optimal process parameters. The proposed methods for assessing the quality indicators of control systems are proposed for use in digital signal processing, control systems and other applications related to the analysis of dynamic systems.

articleTitle: Setting and Checking Availability Requirements for Communication Networks and Systems
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Dependability requirements are increasing with each new generation of communication networks and systems. Availability is one of the core dependability attributes and dependability requirements are often set as requirements specifically for availability. Therefore, it is very important correctly specify such requirements and validate compliance with them. These issues are studied in this paper. A parametric approach with a time over threshold is proposed to determine failure and restoration criteria. The choice of availability measures for communication networks is considered. The features and difficulties of applying the calculation method and tests to validate compliance with requirements at the design and commissioning stages are discussed.

articleTitle: Software Defined Radio Four-Element Antenna Array Design with Nanosecond Synchronisation
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This paper is devoted to the design of a fourelement antenna array system, based on a software defined radio (SDR) hardware, accompanying developed software, its configuration and performance evaluation. Four NI USRP 2932 boards are used to build SDR hardware system. For synchronization of SDR boards clock signals of 1PPS and 10 MHz are used, sources of which are the Metronome-PTP-1U precision time server and Metronome-T signal translator. We propose an approach development and its software realization for configuration and synchronization of SDR boards in the USRP Hardware Driver (UHD) environment, which allows to control the alignment of the timestamps and phases of several SDR boards and takes into account inherent time and phase instability of the boards own clock generators. Proposed approach and its software realization allow to provide time and frequency synchronisation with predictable and compensated phase shifts between RF channels of several SDR boards. The nanosecond time and frequency (phase) synchronisation in accordance with the proposed approach has been assessed.

articleTitle: Analysis of Existing Attacks on the Data Transmission Channel Between the Unmanned Aerial Vehicles and the Control Center
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper analyzes existing threats aimed at the data transmission channel between unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) and control centers (CC). Threats, the implementation of which has the greatest destructive impact, including interception, substitution, and denial of service, are identified. During the analysis, threats, attack mechanisms, potential information security risks, and information protection methods are structured. Based on the results of the work, practical recommendations are proposed to improve the security of the data transmission channel between UAVs and CC, and promising areas for future research in this area are highlighted.

articleTitle: Error Analysis of Generating 3D Models of Objects Using Various Hardware Systems
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article is devoted to a comparative analysis of software and hardware systems for creating small-sized three-dimensional (3D) models. The paper discusses various methods for generating and evaluating the quality of 3D objects, such as photogrammetry, TrueDepth (FaceID), and LiDAR. It also offers a classification of 3D objects by size, which will help in choosing the appropriate methods of analysis and model generation. The article is intended for experts, students, visualization specialists and those interested in 3D content.

articleTitle: Monitoring of Packet Telecommunication Networks
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article explores of monitoring of packet telecommunication networks. With requirements increasing for ensuring the quality of communication services provided, it is necessary to increase the efficiency of monitoring the performance indicators of transmission systems and processing of packet traffic when providing communication services. To solve this problem, various methods of monitoring and testing the operability of these systems at each level of the OSI model are used, taking into account the features of the functioning of the systems when providing specific communication services or a set of them. An analysis of various methods for monitoring both the quality of communication networks and the quality of communication services shows that the measuring complex VECTOR-2019 can be used to solve the above problems.

articleTitle: Analysis of Explainable Artificial Intelligence Methods in Security Information and Event Management Systems
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The present article engages with the ongoing discourse surrounding the implementation of artificial intelligence and explainable artificial intelligence within the domain of information security systems. In the context of escalating cyber threats and mounting data volumes, conventional defense methodologies are proving to be inadequate. Consequently, the integration of artificial intelligence has emerged as a pivotal strategy to enhance the efficacy of threat detection and response processes. The article delves into the intricacies of explainability in artificial intelligence decision-making, exploring explainable artificial intelligence techniques such as local interpretable model-agnostic explanations, shapley additive explanations, gradient-weighted class activation mapping, and layer-wise relevance propagation. These techniques facilitate a more profound comprehension of the rationale behind artificial intelligence models' decisions, thereby enhancing the interpretability of these models. The discourse further encompasses the trade-offs between the accuracy and explainability of artificial intelligence models, along with their potential applications in security information management systems to enhance the efficiency and quality of incident analysis. The integration of explainable artificial intelligence into information security systems has the potential to enhance user confidence in artificial intelligence technologies and optimize human-machine interaction.

articleTitle: Comparison of Codebooks for Non-Orthogonal Multiple Access SCMA
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The ever-increasing demand for high-capacity and low-latency communications in next-generation wireless networks has driven the evolution of advanced multiple access techniques. Among these, Sparse Code Multiple Access (SCMA) has emerged as a promising non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) scheme, offering the advantages of massive connectivity and enhanced spectral efficiency through the use of sparse multidimensional codebooks. This paper presents a comprehensive comparative analysis of various SCMA codebook designs under realistic fading channel conditions. In this work, we review key NOMA paradigms-from power-domain to codedomain techniques-and examine the SCMA system framework, highlighting the critical role of sparsity in codebook construction. In addition, decoding techniques, notably the message passing algorithm (MPA) and maximum likelihood (ML) detection, are discussed in terms of their trade-offs between performance and computational complexity. The insights gained from this study offer practical guidelines for optimizing SCMA systems, thereby contributing to the development of robust and efficient communication frameworks for future 5G-Advanced and 6G networks.

articleTitle: Modified Unitary Data Storage Method
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article is intended to consider a method of data storage based on the use of a modified relative unary coding system. During the research, it is planned to develop a data storage algorithm using relative unary code. It is planned to identify the disadvantages and advantages of the proposed algorithm. Suggest a method for the utilitarian application of the developed algorithm for relative information storage. Provide formulas for the utilitarian application of the developed algorithm for relative information storage. To test the functionality of the model, create software that implements the developed algorithm for relative information storage. Show that the information sequences used in the method are mutually orthogonal and belong to the orthonormal Euclidean space. Establish additional ways to reduce information redundancy that increase the compression ratio of the unary data encoding method. Adapt the data compression method by encoding the lengths of the series for use in the developed algorithm for relative information storage. Evaluate the efficiency of data storage in the relative storage algorithm.

articleTitle: On the Performance of Specialized Distributed Computing Systems Using Multiple Parallel Task Queues
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Three variants of models of specialized distributed computing systems containing one, two and four parallel task queues are considered. Such systems are characterized by continuous non-stationary internal task flows. In these systems, the input tasks are parallelized into an a priori unknown number of data-independent subtasks. And when a certain subtask containing a solution is completed, all other branches of this task are deleted. The aim of the work was to study the behavior of such systems when they are organized with several parallel queues. The issues of changing the efficiency and performance of such systems with an increase in the number of queues are considered. Studies have shown that the use of several queues makes it possible to increase productivity without increasing computing resources.

articleTitle: Creating Hybrid Computing Architectures for Data Centers
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This is article examines the issue of new conceptual architectures of ultrafast hybrid computing devices based on digital technologies, where the size of an elementary computing device approaches the size of a molecule or even an atom. At this level, the laws of classical physics stop working and quantum laws begin to operate, which for many important dynamic problems have yet to be described theoretically. For such practically significant examples of the use of quantum computers as the training of language models, as well as the analysis of the effectiveness of model training on specified chips and with specified train characteristics (model depth, dataset size, etc.), a new concept for the use of hybrid computing platforms in data centers has emerged. Hybrid computing platforms for data centers represent the integration of various computing resources, including on-premises servers, cloud solutions and virtualized environments. These platforms allow organizations to optimize their computing power, providing flexibility, scalability and costeffectiveness. With the increase in data volumes and the need for cloud services, there is an increase in the creation of data centers. The edge-computing extension, which supports real-time processing at data collection points, matches the potential of quantum computing for revolutionary tasks such as optimization and decision-making. As peripheral systems evolve, the integration of algorithms with quantum technologies can expand their capabilities. This raises pitfalls in evaluating processor performance in hybrid computers, which can vary depending on many factors, including the processor architecture, the types of cores used (for example, high-performance and energy-efficient), as well as the nature of the tasks performed. In this study, a mathematical model of the presented systems is proposed as a combination of combining various concepts that will help to understand and evaluate the performance of hybrid computing, allowing you to optimize the use of resources and improve overall efficiency. Today, there is a growing dependence on hybrid models - mixing local, cloud and peripheral systems, which further emphasizes the need for an infrastructure that accommodates both classical and quantum resources. Quantum computing is increasingly seen as an important part of these hybrid architectures, preparing organizations to meet the new challenges of the advanced computing landscape.

Author Keywords: a mathematical model of the concept of hybrid platforms

articleTitle: Modeling of Multiservice Traffic Service Process in a High-Throughput Satellite Network
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The demand for satellite communication services is increasing every year. One promising solution is high-throughput satellite (HTS) networks in geostationary Earth orbit (GEO). To provide high-speed communications over a large area on the Earth's surface, HTS nodes use multi-beam onboard antennas. Modern communication systems handle multiservice traffic, including real-time and elastic traffic, requiring efficient radio resource management. This paper addresses the problem of servicing multiservice traffic in an HTS node, where elastic traffic service rates are constrained. To evaluate quality-of-service (QoS) metrics, a mathematical model based on Markov process theory is developed. Efficient resource utilization while meeting strict QoS requirements is crucial; therefore, an approximate method is introduced to estimate key service parameters. The proposed method is both fast and accurate, enabling real-time computation for resource planning and optimization tasks. Its performance is evaluated through numerical experiments, demonstrating its effectiveness in the low-loss region of request servicing. Furthermore, the method is applied to a channel resource planning problem, illustrating its efficiency in determining the minimum resource requirements needed to meet predefined QoS targets.

articleTitle: To the Issue of Switcher Simulation with Multiservice Traffic Impact
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Improving the quality of service in telecommunication networks is directly related to improving the algorithms for routing with packet switching. Such networks are characterized by the multiservice nature of traffic, whose statistical properties in most cases are of a complex polymodal nature. Given the fact that traditional Poisson models providing FIFO servicing of network traffic leads to overly optimistic results in terms of delays for solving modern telecommunication problems, there is a need to develop a new mathematical model of a unidirectional switch providing FIFO servicing of multiservice traffic with polymodal distribution, taking into account the necessary quality of subscriber service and an algorithm for assessing its main parameters. As the result of this paper the new mathematical model of a unidirectional switcher implementing FIFO servicing of multiservice traffic with polymodal distribution has been developed, allowing one to estimate the probability that packets arriving at the switch input will not be processed due to overflow of its buffer memory and exceeding the maximum packet processing time. The model takes into account the delays introduced by the channel and channel equipment during the distribution and processing of packets from the source to the switch in question. Practical significance. Recommendations for modeling traffic processing to ensure the specified accuracy of the results are presented. Recommendations for traffic processing simulation are presented to ensure the required accuracy of the obtained results.

articleTitle: Application of Virtualization and Containerization Technologies in IP Telephony
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article considers the contemporary trends that telecommunication companies are facing in the rapidly changing technological environment. One of the trends is the technology of network virtualization, which allows to significantly increase the efficiency of network resources through the organization of multiple virtual resources based on one physical resource. The objective of this study is to analyze new tools available for the implementation of a virtual IP PBX. Virtualization and containerization technologies that affect the efficient operation of VoIP services are studied in the paper. The implementation of these technologies has been shown to facilitate more efficient use of server resources and more secure interaction with multiple tools for analyzing system operation. The principles of integrating software telephone exchanges into the virtualized environment are considered. Special attention is paid to the integration of a virtual Asterisk exchange into the containerized environment. Approaches to automating Asterisk's deployment and management in the microservice architecture using a Kubernetes platform are also considered. It is recommended that virtualization and containerization technologies should be incorporated into the curricula of technical universities.)

articleTitle: Jagerman Approximation of Erlang Processes in On-Board Computing Systems Models
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The design of on-board computer systems associates with a large number of calculations and the implementation of complex algorithms. Analytical and simulation models develop for this purpose. These models must take into account a significant number of factors, which include environmental influences, load fluctuations, and others. Queuing theory methods widely uses in modeling on-board computer systems. Queuing network models may be either open or closed. It becomes possible to take into account the network users operation technology when calculating the characteristics of this a model in the latter case. It is necessary to use special software or develop your own programs using algorithmic programming languages in any case. The processes taking place in on-board computer networks describes by the Erlang processes. Software implementation of it has been has quite complicated for a long time. In 1974 Jagerman develops a fast algorithm that implemented Erlang formula however. This paper provides examples of models and programs that allow you calculate the characteristics of on-board computer systems with a complex structure of user dialogue based on the Jagerman algorithm and Brown method for solution of nonlinear equations.

articleTitle: Improving the Efficiency of Adaptive Operation of the Decameter Communication Line
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Increasing the noise immunity of a digital radio communication system (decameter communication line) through the use of software equalizers is a modern and relevant topic for the development of adaptation algorithms and mechanisms for using signal-code sequences for such a radio link. It is necessary to provide fundamentally new solutions for the task of creating ionospheric radio communication lines. A critical condition for each of these options is the effect of the Doppler shift. The study highlights the importance of adaptive technologies to ensure stable and reliable communications in a volatile and heterogeneous distribution environment. The proposed method of reducing the effect of Doppler shift by using a channel equalizer contains new ideas about using the variability of the signal preamble to adjust the receiver. Contribution. The simulation results showed that the use of equalizers significantly increases noise immunity, reducing the required signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) at a given level of bit errors (BER) by 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup>.

articleTitle: Trajectory Mining for Vehicle Speed Characteristics Using Traffic Video-Analysis
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The modern development of information technology and artificial intelligence leads to the accumulation of large volumes of spatiotemporal data in various areas of human activity. This is especially true in the field of transport, where intelligent transport system devices accumulate data in various formats, including video and satellite positioning data. This article presents an approach for real-time traffic analysis for trajectory using computer vision techniques. The proposed method involves object detection, tracking, and trajectory estimation of vehicles. A deep learning-based YOLO11 model is employed for vehicle detection, while CSRT (Channel and Spatial Reliability Tracking) tracking is used for continuous monitoring of vehicle movements. Additionally, instantaneous speed estimation is integrated into the system, providing a more accurate representation of traffic dynamics. Comparison of trajectories is carried out based on Lp-norms. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method in various urban traffic scenarios.

articleTitle: Experimental Research of the Adaptive Noise Suppression Algorithm Based on the Digital Filter Bank
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Broadband signals have the ability to operate in frequency ranges occupied by systems using narrowband signals, which allows reusing the frequency resource, which is especially valuable for the shortwave range. Thus, taking into account the advantages described above, the issue of developing interference rejection algorithms and devices is relevant. To study the impact on the communication quality and the number of transmission errors was chosen an adaptive interference suppression method based on a digital filter bank and providing frequency-selective suppression of narrowband interference. The purpose of this work is to determine the influence of the studied algorithm parameters on the direct spread spectrum communication system noise immunity in order to reduce the computational complexity of the interference rejection module without significant deterioration in noise immunity. To solve the problem, frame success ratio and signal-to-noise ratio at the output of the matched filter used to detect the synchronization sequence dependencies on the number of filter bank channels and the overlapping factor were obtained, which allows to determine the computational complexity of the rejection algorithm and find minimum required number of elementary operations at which there is no degradation in the quality of interference suppression.

articleTitle: The Balance Model for V2X System with Variable Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This paper addresses the optimization problem and seeks a balance equation between key performance-influencing parameters in a Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) network. A novel mathematical optimization model is proposed, focusing on the interaction between On-Board Units (OBUs) and both stationary and mobile Roadside Units (RSUs/mRSUs). The optimization problem is expressed through a multi-objective function considering critical parameters such as data transmission latency, energy consumption, and resource availability. The study demonstrates how RSU density and mobility impact key network performance indicators, including system stability and data loss percentage during peak hours. This work provides a structured analytical approach to optimizing Intelligent Transportation System (ITS) infrastructure, ensuring more reliable and efficient communication between vehicles.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of TimeGPT, Time-LLM and MSET Models and Methods for Transport Telematics
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In this study, a comparative analysis of the TimeGPT, Time-LLM, and traditional MSET methods was performed on car telematics data, including such parameters as the degree of gas pedal pressure, speed, and steering wheel deflection. Forecast accuracy was assessed using MSE, MAPE and R2 metrics. The results showed that TimeGPT significantly outperforms MSET in accuracy, with MSE 0.023 vs. 0.035 for MSET, and MAPE 4.5% vs. 7.2%, respectively. The Time-LLM model also demonstrated good results, although it was inferior to TimeGPT in terms of accuracy. The data processing time for the TimeGPT and Time-LLM models was slightly higher, however, this is justified by their higher accuracy. The implementation of these models in transport systems can significantly increase safety and efficiency, optimizing routes and improving the prediction of vehicle behavior. The results confirm the potential of using modern models of time series analysis to improve the management of transport systems.

articleTitle: Investigation of Using Frank Sequences Sossibility in C-OChDM
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Currently, due to the rapid development of the Internet of Things, the growth in the number of devices requiring code division leads to a shortage of orthogonal code sequences to meet the needs of communication systems. This article proposes to use quantized Frank sequences for orthogonal code division of subscribers in the orthogonal code-chirp division multiplexing technology to expand the ensemble of code sequences for dividing devices. In the orthogonal code-chirp division multiplexing technology, the code sequences of subscribers divided by the ensemble are transmitted on a set of frequency subchannels with a linear-frequency carrier frequency. The comparative effect of quantized Frank sequences on the noise immunity of such a communication system is analyzed on the bit error rate dependencies.

articleTitle: On the Applicability of Reinforcement Learning in the Traffic Flow Control Problem
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article presents the development of a traffic flow regulation method based on an adaptive approach that accounts for changing characteristics of traffic conditions. The study explores key reinforcement learning techniques utilizing Q-Learning to enhance traffic management. Simulations of traffic flow control were conducted in the SUMO simulation environment, focusing on cyclic switching methods. The article outlines the implementation of an environment management strategy and the application of reinforcement learning algorithms via the SUMO API. Two reinforcement learning techniques were selected for traffic flow regulation, and extensive training was conducted with various hyperparameters to identify optimal configurations. A comparative analysis of traditional cyclic switching methods and data-driven approaches is provided, highlighting the potential advantages of adaptive methods for improving traffic efficiency and safety in urban environments. The findings suggest that reinforcement learning can significantly enhance traffic management systems in real-time applications.

articleTitle: Modeling of Radar Speckle Images
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Modern approaches to parametric modeling of speckle images of terrain fragments obtained by radar sensing from an on-board carrier are being investigated. Speckle formation processes are analyzed in detail, taking into account the spectral properties of the reflecting surface. The models of gamma-speckles and K-speckles that take into account fluctuations of the radar cross section (RCS), as well as a model using a generalized Gaussian distribution for components of a complex image, are considered. The results of a comparative analysis of the parameters of models and real speckle images are presented.

articleTitle: A Model for Predicting the Load on the Service
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In order to quickly respond to emergencies, it is necessary not only to hone the process of collecting the recovery team and the recovery process, but also to be able to anticipate the days of increased workload. Thanks to forecasting,the recovery team can prepare and prevent an emergency situation as a result of an increased load on the service.

articleTitle: Research Teams Collaborative Work Analysis within the IEEE Conference “Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of On-Board Communications”
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article analyzes results of the IEEE Conference “2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of On-Board Communications”. An example of organizing research teams collaborative work in an expanded format with Chairs of IEEE regional Sections, Chapters and Joint Chapters, is considered. Current data on the regional Chapters distribution and IEEE Societies within Sections R80059, R80087 and R80089 are generated and structured.

articleTitle: Video Stabilization Quality Assessment Method Based on K-Means in HSV Color Space
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In recent times, there has been a notable increase in the need to shoot videos for social media and video-sharing sites. However, many people complain about the shaking of the camera while shooting videos. To overcome this obstacle, various kinds of stabilization techniques were invented and have helped improve video quality. This work surveys other approaches used to measure the quality of video and proposes a new method to measure the degree of video stabilization. The approach employs color quantization based on the k-means algorithm. It has been tested on various video sequences, motion histograms have been turned out to be a useful tool for measuring the stability of images along with the computed parameters based on them.

articleTitle: Influence of Primary and Secondary Path Estimation Accuracy on Active Noise Control Performance
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: An Active Noise Control (ANC) system based on a modified architecture is considered. This architecture allows to accelerate the convergence of the adaptive filtering algorithms in use. Besides, it allows to use the most efficient Recursive Least Squares adaptive filtering algorithms which provide the fastest convergence comparing to the gradient search-based adaptive algorithms. The architecture of the ANC system and its mathematic description are presented. The simulation results demonstrate the ANC system performance. It is shown, that the number of the adaptive filter weighs can be decreased about 30% of the theoretically required value without any observable loss of the ANC performance. This is possible because of fading shape of the primary and secondary path acoustic impulse responses. As the result, the contribution of the impulse response “tails” to the signals at the error microphone of the ANC system is comparable with that of the ambient noise. This also allows to decrease the required number of the adaptive filter weights and to decrease the computational resources required to the implementation of the ANC system.

articleTitle: Development of LoRa Communication System Generator Simulation Model
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Today LoRa data transmission technology is gaining more and more popularity among Internet devices for collecting information and communication. The main purpose of LoRa technology is to collect simple information in small packets transmitted at a low speed. Information is collected from various sensors and devices located within the range of the main receiver. This technology complements Wi-Fi. It is suitable for applications with a long range, low transmission speed and power consumption. WiFi provides a short range, low speed and power consumption. LoRa technology is constantly being improved, in connection with which monitoring radio networks built on its basis is of current importance for implementation and study (during the educational process). Modeling of radio communication algorithms in LoRa data transmission technology is one of the important research areas for the development of radio networks of this type. In this regard, this paper develops software that generates files of digital readings of the LoRa radio signal quadratures.

articleTitle: Research Information Security System in Event-Based Security and Reliability Management
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Some indicators of the effectiveness management based on security and reliability events of the information security system are analyzed. Network services and applications active monitoring security and reliability events are considered, where the main management tools are the composition of events, their effectiveness indicators used to indicate an incident, and their parameters. Based on the study, a new approach to creating a mathematical model has been developed. Taking into account the features of the model, this paper considers the tasks studying the communication quality indicators of the information security system and assessing their effectiveness in managing based on security and reliability events. Using the model, analytical expressions have been obtained for assessing the performance indicators managing based on security and reliability events hardware and software complexes communication systems.

articleTitle: Motion Planning of the Industrial Manipulator in the Target Space
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper deals with the features of motion planning of the KUKA KR4 R600 industrial robot manipulator in the target space of the robot cell. The results of automated generation of a training data set for the neural network model of the manipulator control system are presented. An analysis of the different types of motion characteristic of typical robot manipulators PTP, LIN, CIRC and SPLINE and a software implementation of the calculation of the direct kinematics of the manipulator has been carried out. The obtained results can be applied to the tasks of autonomous control of industrial robots and increasing their stability to external constraints.

articleTitle: Method for Transforming Matrix Circulants of Multiposition Linear Recurrence Sequences Into Matrices of Vilenkin-Crestenson Functions
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The variants of constructing the circulant matrices of any p-ary linear recurrent sequence (LRS) of maximal period on the basis of automorphic multiplicative groups of the extended Galois field constructed by means of an irreducible primitive polynomial, on the basis of which the original p-ary LRS is formed, have been developed. As a result of this approach, new ways of transforming the circulant matrices of p-ary LRSs into the matrix of Vilenkin-Krestenson functions ordered by degrees of the primitive element of the field are revealed. It is shown for the first time that, depending on the initial conditions of the transformation, the set of arbitrary cyclic shifts of the p-ary LRS, shifted by one symbol relative to each other, can be transformed into arbitrary successive rows of the ordered matrix of Vilenkin-Krestenson functions. This fact makes it possible to simplify the algorithm of synchronisation of the p-ary LRS in a known range of its cyclic shifts, especially in the case of large periods of its repetition, and also to reduce the computational complexity of the processing algorithm when working in the truncated basis of the Vilenkin-Krestenson functions.

Author Keywords: p-ary linear recurrent sequences of maximum period

articleTitle: A Separation of Speech Sources Based on Dual MVDR Beamformer
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Microphone arrays (MA) techniques are widely applied into numerous acoustic devices for speech enhancement. Because of the spatial information, MA beamforming has the capacity of processing multiple desired or undesired sources in a complex and annoying environment, approximately localizing sound. Nowadays, various applications that are arising in the field of teleconference systems, hands-free mobile phones, automatic speech recognition, smart-home, surveillance equipment present new challenges for speech enhancement algorithms. Minimum Variance Distortionless Response (MVDR) beamformer is the most effective algorithm for saving the original clean speech data, eliminating the unwanted background noise without speech distortion. Because of the different microphone sensitivities, the error of sampling rate, the inaccurate estimation of preferred incident angle of useful signal, the imprecise MA distribution or designed MA geometry, the MVDR beamformer's performance significantly degraded. In this article, the author considered the problem of separating sound speech in the realistic consecutive conversation between two speakers. The authors proposed an additive method, which enhances the MVDR beamformer's evaluation in extracting each individual. The promising results obtained have confirmed the effectiveness of the author's proposed method in real-life situations. The author's illustrated approach can be integrated into a multi-channel signal processing system for solving several complex problems.

articleTitle: Model of Compensation for the Influence of Non-Identicality of Phase Distribution of the Active Phased Antenna Array on Radar Accuracy Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Increasing requirements to the range of object detection together with increasing density of the radar station equipment arrangement for space monitoring causes the emergence of destructive factors affecting the accuracy characteristics of object coordinates determination. Destructive factors affect the accuracy characteristics through changes in the amplitude-phase-frequency characteristics of the transceiver path and amplitude-phase distribution on the web. To compensate for such influences, it is necessary to estimate both the significance of the dephasing factor and the nature of its changes. The simulation modeling showed the necessity to take into account the antenna array defuzzification and its influence on the accuracy characteristics.

articleTitle: Measurement of Video Camera Parameters for Video Recording of Fast Moving Objects
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In this article, we explored ways to measure video camera parameters that are important for shooting video of fastmoving objects. Fast-moving objects introduce additional distortions into the video recording if the video camera is not adapted to such an operating mode. Geometric distortions, blurs and incorrect brightness transfer are formed on the video recording. There are several ways to avoid or reduce the negative effects introduced during video shooting. The first is to use a technically more advanced video camera with improved quality properties. The second is to collect additional information during video shooting and use it to restore the original image. For both cases, it is necessary to know the actual parameters of the video camera. The method described in the article is based on the Rolling Shater and Wagon Wheel effects.

articleTitle: On the Automated Selection of Neural Network Architectures in the Task of Pattern Recognition for Intelligent Transportation Systems
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Exponential growth in the number of computing resources, their cheapening, and the wide availability of large data sets have ensured a great demand for information systems based on neural networks. Such systems are widely used in many spheres of life: in medicine, detecting diseases at early stages and helping to design new drugs; in the financial sector, detecting fraudulent transactions and calculating risks, including the development of intelligent transportation systems. Intelligent transportation systems (ITS) actively use computer vision technologies to solve such tasks as object recognition, traffic analysis, traffic forecasting and road safety. However, the development of effective neural network models for these tasks requires significant resources and high qualification of specialists. The system of automated training and selection of neural network architecture can significantly simplify and speed up this process. Data collection, selection of the necessary model and tuning of hyperparameters requires specialized knowledge and skills. This work is aimed at developing a tool for automated selection of neural network architecture, which will accelerate the development and implementation of models, reduce development costs, improve the quality and reliability of solutions, provide scalability and adaptability to changing conditions.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Earth's Ionosphere Influence on the Parameters of High-Frequency Radio Signals Using the Bicharacteristics Method
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The propagation of a radio signal emitted by a spacecraft through the Earth's ionosphere is considered. The influence of the ionosphere and traveling ionospheric disturbances on the propagation of a radio signal of the decimeter and meter ranges is studied. The following are calculated: deviations of rays from rectilinear propagation, changes in delay time, phase lag, and phase deviation. The total electron concentration and Faraday rotation are calculated in the presence of ionospheric inhomogeneities. The influence of the ionosphere on the absorption of a radio signal, its amplitude, and polarization is analyzed.

articleTitle: Research and Optimization of the Algorithm for License Plate Recognition Under the Conditions of Edge Computations
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Purpose of this paper is to develop a license plate detection and recognition module optimized to work under constraint of edge computing. Existing methods of license plate recognition are analyzed. Dataset with images of rectangular and square license plates is collected. Detector is trained, methods of processing detected license plate frame and checking combination of symbols are implemented. Pipeline using convolutional recurrent network for character recognition adapted for license plates is developed. Influence of hyperparameters on speed and accuracy of license plate character recognition has been investigated. Experiments have demonstrated obtaining an optimal configuration for module inference with sufficiently high accuracy rates and possibility of operation under conditions of limited computational resources in real time.

articleTitle: Simulation of Analog Filter Using Digital Element Base
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: It has been suggested to design analog devices using elementary units of the automatic control theory in order to reduce the labor consumption of the design process. The elementary units have been simulated and implemented on the basis of digital elements. It has been shown that the elementary units studied can be configured into specific analog devices. The correctness of the suggested method has been verified for the example of the simulation and design of an analog filter circuit on the basis of digital elements

articleTitle: Dolby Surround Sound Applications in DRM Digital Radio Broadcasting
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The technical feasibility of using Dolby Stereo/Dolby Surround sound technologies to improve music programs perception in the Digital Radio Mondiale (DRM) digital radio broadcasting system in the low (LF), medium (MF) and high (HF) frequency ranges is considered. The technical feasibility of this proposal is shown in the “stereo” and “parametric stereo” modes when broadcasting in the 9/10 kHz frequency bandwidth in the transmission mode “A” with 64QAM modulation and protection levels “1”, “2” and “3” (in the LF and MF ranges), and in the transmission mode “B” with 64QAM modulation and protection levels “2” or “3” - in stable HF range channels with 10 kHz frequency bandwidth.

articleTitle: Theoretical Calculation of Protective Screen for Base Stations of Cellular Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Currently, base stations of cellular communication systems are widely used and installed everywhere in different parts of the world. At the same time, some maintenance conditions require protection of base stations of cellular communication systems from mechanical damage to devices of the antenna-feeder path of base stations of modern cellular communication systems. The using a protective screen is proposed and a theoretical justification is given for the possibility of application of the developed technical means of ensuring the safety of base station systems of modern cellular communication systems. The parameters of the protective screen and its effect on the propagation of signals of modern cellular communication systems were studied.

articleTitle: Selecting the Optimal Modulation Format for Transport Fiber-Optic Communication Lines
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The choice and dynamics of the change of multilevel modulation formats on transport fiber-optic communication lines over a long period of time is considered. The total discounted capital expenditures for their implementation are selected as a criterion function. It is shown that with minimal discounted capital expenditures, we obtain the maximum value of the project's economic efficiency indicator, net present value. The difference in approaches to the introduction of new modulation formats for short and long communication lines is pointed out. The results of calculations for various scenarios of changing modulation formats are presented, and recommendations are given.

articleTitle: Intelligent System for Diagnostics and Detection of External Vehicle Damages
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In this paper, an approach to detecting vehicle damage using deep learning and computer vision methods is presented. The aim of the study is to develop an automated system for identifying various types of external damage to vehicles, such as scratches, dents, and cracks, to enhance damage assessment speed and reduce costs. The YOLOv10 model is employed for damage detection, utilizing both the CarDD dataset and a custom dataset created from the vehicle fleet of a large ecommerce company, containing annotated images of vehicles with diverse defect types. The study includes a comparative analysis of different model configurations and the effectiveness of various neural network formats. The proposed system architecture integrates the trained model, providing reliable and efficient detection of external vehicle damage.

articleTitle: Diffraction of a Nonharmonic Signal on a Spatially Periodic Structure of a Sawtooth Profile
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: One of the directions of improving the characteristics of radar systems is the use of ultra-wideband sounding signals. This increases the radar's resolution in all coordinates, stealth of operation, noise immunity, and the possibility of identifying targets on the basis of their radio image. The probability of target detection and stability of target tracking increases. There are a number of difficulties in the process of generation, emission, propagation and reception of ultra-wideband signals. As a model of periodic inhomogeneities of the underlying surface in the propagation of non-harmonic signal in some cases use spatially periodic structures of sawtooth profile. The purpose of the research is to develop a numerical method for solving the problem of diffraction of non-sinusoidal electromagnetic waves on a spatially periodic structure of a sawtooth profile in order to model the propagation of ultrawideband signal over the sea surface. A semi-reversal and frequency method has been used, allowing the use of previously obtained solutions for the harmonic case. A modified method for calculating the scattered field when irradiating a sawtooth profile grating with an ultra-wideband electromagnetic wave is presented. The data of the experiment carried out on the ultrawideband measuring complex show a satisfactory coincidence with the results of numerical calculations and thus confirm the correctness of the mathematical model. The proposed numerical method is an effective means of taking into account the influence of periodic inhomogeneities of the underlying surface on the propagation of a non-harmonic electromagnetic wave. The influence of geometrical and electrophysical characteristics (period, angle of asymmetry, impedance) of the grating on the structure of the scattered field is investigated in detail.

articleTitle: Content Delivery Network for E-Learning Based on Enterprise Service Bus
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Learning management systems are an important element of the educational process, providing students with a variety of educational material and giving teachers the opportunity to monitor students' knowledge and assess their progress. However, an increase in the number of students leads to the growth of the load on data transmission channels, which can negatively affect the quality of education. To solve this problem, content delivery networks are used, which speed up the loading of web resources and reduce the workload on servers. An enterprise service bus can significantly improve the performance of content distribution algorithms in a content delivery network. It is especially useful in distance learning, where fast and reliable delivery of educational material, feedback, performance analytics and other functions are required. In this work the features and benefits of using an integration bus to optimize content delivery network operation within learning management systems are discussed. The results of experiments using the content delivery network with an algorithm for optimizing content delivery based on the integration bus 1C:Bus are presented. It is shown that the average time of content distribution across network nodes is reduced by 25%. Implementation of an integration data bus in a distance learning system can significantly improve the efficiency and quality of the educational process.

articleTitle: Methodological Support for the Development of Professional Competencies of Students and Graduates in Telecommunication Specialties in the Field of Project Management
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The aim of the research is to improve the methodological support for the development of professional competencies in project management among students specializing in telecommunications and employees of telecommunication companies. The educational and methodological material has been prepared based on an analysis of the current state, dynamics, and trends in the development of telecommunications, a study of the features of ongoing telecommunication projects, and a comparative analysis of modern methodological approaches to project management and their application by telecommunication companies. The research resulted in a training and methodological complex for developing professional competencies of students and graduates specializing in telecommunications in the field of engineering and IT project management. The bank of cases, business games, and practical tasks developed by the authors ensures that students gain practical skills. The study is aimed at improving the quality of the educational process of training specialists for the telecommunications industry.

articleTitle: Modern Approach to Organization of Digital Electronics Classes
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Modern methods of teaching digital electronics rely on computer modeling which often leads to misunderstanding of some core design principles by students. This article is devoted to organizing classes in digital electronics using breadboard modelling for more evident explanation of main digital circuit development concepts. The article describes the method of organizing a physical model, its internal structure, and operating principle, which is proposed for implementation and subsequent use in laboratory practical for the course “Digital Circuitry.” This model serves as a way to demonstrate to students the fundamental rules of Boolean algebra in practice, as well as an opportunity to assemble various basic digital circuits whose operation is based on the same rules.

articleTitle: Qualitie of Communication Fiber-Optic Transmission Systems Using Wave Multiplexing Technology
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article considers the problems research methods and means improvement of indicators communication quality of fiber-optic transmission systems using the technology spectral and dense spectral multiplexing optical signals with frequency and time division of optical communication channels. Based on the research communication quality, methods of calculation indicators noise immunity reception optical signals in fiber-optic transmission systems using the technology wave multiplexing are proposed. Based on the methods calculating the quality of communication, important analytical expressions were obtained that evaluate the required optical signal-to-noise ratio, receiver sensitivity, permissible losses, average signal powers, bit error probability, and power penalty. For comparative analysis, graphical dependencies of the penalty for the optical signal power in a single-mode fiber on the extinction coefficient of the modulator in the transmitting optical module were given.)

articleTitle: The Development of a Respiration Signal Detecting Algorithm Exploiting Cyclostationary Properties
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper presents an algorithm for processing secondary radar signals that is based on identification of the characteristic cyclic frequencies specific to the breathing signals of a motionless human. The main procedure of the algorithm consists in sequential processing of signals contained in the range lines of a radar frame. It includes pre-processing to remove lowfrequency offset and high-frequency noise, generating an estimate of the spectral correlation function and calculating pseudo-power based on it, and selecting cyclic frequencies exceeding a variable threshold. The operation of the algorithm is demonstrated using experimental data obtained using a radar system emitting signals with step frequency modulation. The proposed algorithm can be used in the development of new and modernization of existing technical solutions, such as radar systems for non-contact monitoring of the health conditions, highly specialized radars detecting survivors in rubble or electronic aids for people with disabilities.

articleTitle: Exploring the Use of Machine Learning to Identify Threats in Powershell Scripts
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: PowerShell is a widely utilized tool by both system administrators and attackers for performing complex management tasks and launching attacks. The detection of malicious scripts poses a significant cybersecurity challenge due to the use of various obfuscations and the intricacy of analyses. This paper aims to provide a comprehensive overview of state-of-the-art techniques for detecting malicious PowerShell scripts using machine learning. It also discusses the potential integration of these techniques into SIEM (Security information and event management) systems to enhance threat detection. The final section of the paper puts forward a novel approach based on deep neural networks that utilizes a recurrent network architecture with deployed layers. Experimental results demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed model in accurately and reliably classifying obfuscated and complex scripts.

articleTitle: System Aspects of Multichannel Fiber Applications in Optical Transport Networks
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The generalizing indicators of the use of optical more than one in transport fibers with the number of spatial channels of transports telecommunication networks for the perspective period 2030–2035 are investigated in the article. Fiber, cable and relevant equipment are considered as a unified systematic complex. In the article the quality of fibers is compared with their efficiency, as long as the effectiveness of the “achieved - required” result type and the type of “result - resource” is evaluated. The concept of ensuring the optimal use of multi-channel fibers in telecommunications transport is selected in the form of quality optimization. The values of the system parameters for the dimensions of the optical fiber shell for the 125 μm and 250 μm are calculated, the number of spatial channels 1–64, modulation formats DP-GPSK, DP-16QAM, DP-64QAM.

articleTitle: Integration of Financial Education and Project Management for Students Studying Electrical Engineering and Electronic Engineering
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In today's world, where technology is rapidly developing and the labor market is becoming more competitive, financial education and project management skills should become an integral part of the preparation of students studying electrical engineering and electronic engineering. These areas require not only deep technical knowledge, but also the ability to effectively manage resources, make informed decisions, and work as a team. The integration of financial education and project management into the learning process creates a unique opportunity for students to develop not only technical skills, but also important competencies necessary for successful professional activity. This will prepare them for the challenges of the modern labor market and help them become highly qualified specialists capable of making a significant contribution to the development of the industry.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Potential of AI-Powered Writing Evaluation Tools for Developing Students' Analytical Skills
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In the contemporary context of learning, the utilisation of artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as a pivotal concern, particularly concerning the diligent employment of neural networks by students as a medium to augment learning, as opposed to their utilisation as a mere executor of tasks derived from textbooks. This paper delves into the realm of students' engagement with AI-powered tools, offering feedback on their written compositions, summaries, articles, etc. during their university education.
