The scientific significance of this study lies in its analysis of the potential of modern automated writing evaluation services using large language models, such as ProWritingAid, Quillbot, MagicSchool and DeepSeek, to encourage students to develop their analytical skills while actively participating in corrective assessment of their writing based on feedback received from the AI tools. The necessity of employing automatic feedback mechanisms is further examined within the context of foreign language acquisition for technical students pursuing higher education, with a focus on electronics and electrical engineering as case studies. The analysis yielded recommendations for enhancing the efficacy of feedback provision to students.

articleTitle: Influence of Energy Efficiency on Location Accuracy in Systems Using Spatio- Temporal Signal Processing
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article is devoted to study of influence of changing energy parameter on estimation of accuracy of measuring position parameters of drones by time difference of arrival (TDOA) system through use of spatial-temporal signal processing. In MATLAB modeling of dependences of mean square deviation of radio emission source (RES) position error on signal-to-noise ratio in TDOA system when spatial-temporal signal processing is applied. The description of methodology of building maps of levels of standard deviation of RES position error depending on energy parameter for a system of five receiving points is presented. This approach can be useful in design of TDOA system with spatial-temporal signal processing, since it allows predicting errors received in coverage area. The distinctive feature of technique is that standard deviation of difference-distance measurement depends on mutual location of RES and receiving points.

articleTitle: Forecasting of Reliability Indicators of Base Stations of Cellular Communication Networks Using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article discusses the issues of forecasting the reliability of base stations of cellular communication networks using machine learning algorithms. This task is relevant, as forecasting the reliability of base stations allows timely measures to be taken to prevent equipment failures. For example, replacing the corresponding base station nodes or performing maintenance. All this ensures an increase in QoS in cellular communication systems. An analysis of existing developments in this field has shown that the use of machine learning algorithms is a promising way to predict reliability indicators. The article discusses two of the most popular machine learning algorithms for solving forecasting problems: decision trees and recurrent neural networks. To assess the applicability of these algorithms, a special dataset has been developed that simulates the process of failures in the main elements of the base station: the power supply unit and the RF power amplifier. The simulation results showed high quality forecasting of base station reliability indicators using these algorithms. In particular, the LSTM network provides about 92% accuracy in correctly predicting base station failure.

articleTitle: Features of Adaptive Filtering of Sound Broadcasting Signals in the Frequency Domain
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Various filters used in modern devices for transmitting and processing audio signals are not adaptive to these signals, therefore proposals are being developed use of adaptive filtering based on the modulation representation of signals. It is proposed, using filtering based on nonlinear transposition of the spectrum of a complex signal and its limitation, to resolve the contradiction between the quality of filtering and the speed of restructuring of filter parameters. It is shown that adaptive filtering of broadcast signals allows the formation of a continuous signal in a band, the central frequency of which shifts in accordance with the shift of the maximum of the envelope of the amplitude spectrum, and the passband changes in accordance with the embedded patterns.

articleTitle: A Refined Method for Subjective Assessment of the Warmth and Coldness of Colors
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article is devoted to the study of subjective warmth-coldness of colors for various tasks, primarily color contrasting. The study was conducted for 80 colors at average brightness. Based on the primary data, an inaccurate model was created that allows determining warmer colors for obvious cases. Based on the model, a clarifying method for subjective assessment of warmth-coldness was implemented, which made it possible to reduce the number of subjective tests per subject, thereby increasing the quality of the results. Reducing the number of tests also made it possible to increase the density of the colors in question, which also positively affected the accuracy of the resulting model. The article presents a method for determining warmth-coldness taking into account the inaccurate model, as well as the results of experiments of primary and refined tests. Based on the experimental results, a new model was built, its accuracy was analyzed, and conclusions were made on the possibility of applying the research results for color contrasting. In addition, for convenience and the possibility of using intermediate colors, the model was approximated using polynomial regression, the regression error was analyzed, and conclusions were made on the possibility of practical use of approximated data instead of experimental data.

articleTitle: Method of Automated Dataset Collection for Microwave Filters Synthesis
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This research discusses the method of dataset collection automatization for microwave filter synthesis by integrating machine learning techniques, thus reducing development time. Utilizing the 3D electromagnetic analysis software package, the study involves simulation and collecting geometric parameters and amplitude-frequency characteristics from three variants of passband highly selective microstrip tworesonator combined filters with stepped impedance resonators. In this paper, specific items and restrictions on filter topology creation in the simulation program are discussed, as well the review of the script used for dataset collection and its requirements is given. In addition, a dataset structure and format are described.

articleTitle: The Influence of Economic Factors on the Choice of Educational Trajectories in the Field of Electronic Engineering
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article examines the influence of various economic factors on the choice of educational trajectories of students in the field of electronic engineering. The elements such as the salary level, the demand for specialists in this field, as well as changes in economic policy and financing of education influence the preferences of students and their decisions about further studies are analyzed. The focus is on the relationship between economic conditions and educational choices, as well as the possible consequences for trained professionals and the industry as a whole. The article emphasizes the importance of taking into account economic factors when developing educational programs aimed at the development of electronic engineering.

articleTitle: Distributed Computing Network Technologies for Effective Organization of Online Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Online learning is becoming increasingly popular due to the multitude of amenities and opportunities for the modern student, making education affordable and comfortable. One of the main advantages of online learning is its accessibility: geographical remoteness is no longer an obstacle to obtaining a high-quality education. Students can choose courses without having to move or travel for long periods. However, in order to take full advantage of online learning, it is necessary that the network infrastructure meets expectations and provides access to content and software with minimal delays. This paper examines modern computing network technologies such as content delivery networks, cloud and edge computing, as well as hybrid technologies to improve the performance and scalability of content delivery networks. The advantages of caching and content processing on cloud computing nodes located closer to users are analyzed compared to traditional CDN architectures based on centralized servers. Architectural aspects, implementation challenges, and potential application areas are considered.

articleTitle: Research of Methods for Modeling User Assessments of 3D Content for Extended Reality Systems
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In this article, we will analyze methods for modeling user ratings of a video sequence and their potential application to extended reality systems. The main approaches and algorithms used to evaluate the quality of a video sequence are considered, their advantages and disadvantages for 2D and 3D content are revealed. The aim of the work is to develop our own method for evaluating the quality of 3D models to improve relevance and efficiency, taking into account the features of 3D content, since most of the metrics were created to meet the needs of two-dimensional systems. The research results can be used in the development and optimization of augmented reality systems, as well as in other areas where it is necessary to evaluate the quality of 3D models based on user preferences.

articleTitle: Design and Study of Passive Optical Logic Element “AND” for Application in Photonic Integrated Circuits
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The continuous increase in operating frequencies in information processing and transmission systems, as well as the development and improvement of the element base for the implementation of such systems, naturally led to the emergence of photonics as a direction using optical signals where electrical signals were traditionally used. At the same time, the emergence of new technologies and devices is associated with their high cost, which limits their distribution and implementation in modern technological processes. At this article offered to your attention is devoted to the development and study of a very simple passive optical logic element” AND’, which can be used in the design of photonic integrated circuits or in the construction of optical computing devices for various purposes.

articleTitle: Digital Education of the Future: The Development of a Chatbot as an Innovative Solution in the Field of Education
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Modern technologies of artificial intelligence and natural language processing open up wide opportunities for the transformation of traditional educational practices. This article is devoted to the introduction of chatbots as a promising direction for the development of digital education. The main advantages of using chatbots in education are revealed: individualization of learning, round-the-clock support for students, data mining, resource optimization and increased involvement of students of educational institutions in the educational process

articleTitle: Application of the Garcia-Wachs Algorithm to Build a Minimum Cost Search Tree
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The attribute values of a certain subject area can be ordered according to the probability of their occurrence, and based on them it is possible to build a tree on which to implement a search algorithm and determine whether the search data is valid for the selected attribute. One of the possible structures of the domain representation is a tree, and the search for the necessary attribute can take place on the search tree. In a binary search tree, any internal vertex is connected by two links, either with internal vertices, or with external vertices, or with internal and external ones. The key characteristic of the tree is the cost of the tree, which corresponds to the average length of the path from the root vertex to the outer one. One of the algorithms for building a minimum cost search tree is the Garcia-Wachs algorithm. This algorithm builds an optimal binary tree based on a predefined order. The paper considers various initial states and determines the most suitable ones.

articleTitle: Researching the Efficiency of Machine Learning Methods Used in Forecasting Demand for Certain Types of Goods
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article deals with the problem of improving the efficiency of forecasting demand for certain types of goods. The goal of the study is to determine the most effective machine learning method for this forecasting. The relevance of the work is due to the fact that traditional statistical methods for forecasting demand do not provide the ability to process effectively the currently received volumes of information on sales and trade; besides, not all machine learning methods for predicting numerical values are suitable for the subject area under consideration. The object of the study is the arising demand for certain types of goods. The subject of the study is the effectiveness indicators (or metrics) of machine learning methods used to forecast demand for certain types of goods. When analyzing the subject area, mean absolute error, the root mean square error and coefficient of determination were selected as metrics used to evaluate the effectiveness of a particular method. As a result, the most suitable algorithms for the most effective forecast of demand for various types of goods were identified. Finally, conclusions are drawn.

articleTitle: Development and Research of a Modified Gradient Boosting Method Effectiveness to Solve Applied Problems of Time-Series Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article considers the problem of increasing the accuracy of the gradient boosting method when forecasting timeseries (including demand for equipment or other goods). The aim of the study is to develop a modified gradient boosting method of decision trees for this forecasting. The relevance of the work is due to the fact that the subject area under consideration is characterized by the presence of many different noises and anomalies in datasets. The use of machine learning methods in forecasting such data leads to a decrease in the accuracy of forecasts and the occurrence of the overfitting effect. Despite the tunings of the existing parameters in existing gradient boosting algorithms, this problem remains and leads to the need for additional improvements. The object of the study is time-series. The subject of the study is the indicators (or metrics) of the effectiveness of machine learning methods used to forecast these time-series. As a result, the most suitable methods for reducing the effect of overfitting and the influence of anomalies were considered and identified, which formed the basis for the development of a modified method of gradient boosting trees. Finally, conclusions are drawn.

articleTitle: The Impact of Heterogeneity on Network Resource Allocation Process for Managing Education in Real Time
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The use of technology in education has increased In recent years, especially after the emergence of the COVID-19 pandemic and the trend towards digital learning. Solutions such as e-learning, blended learning, and game-based learning are being used. Virtual Reality (VR) and Augmented Reality (AR) can help significantly change the style of education towards making it more interesting, useful, and possible. Of course, this type of application requires specific traffic characteristics that must be taken into account when allocating resources in the network in order to obtain an acceptable quality of service. The article provides a numerical study of the influence of the heterogeneity property on the characteristics of the joint servicing of information flows of various types in modern networks. To conduct the study, a generalized mathematical model of a network access node is used, and parameters and characteristics are discussed.

articleTitle: Traffic Flow Forecasting Taking Into Account Spatio-Temporal Dynamics: Modernization of Existing Approaches Based on Data from ITS Detectors
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This paper presents an upgraded traffic flow forecasting technique based on adaptive spatial temporal learning with prompts. The improved model aims to increase the accuracy of forecasts and robustness to data changes by optimizing the mechanisms for processing temporal and spatial characteristics. To evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed approach, experiments were conducted on the PEMS03, PEMS04, PEMS07M and Chengdu Didi datasets. The results showed that the proposed model reduces MAE by 5.4% and RMSE by 4.8% compared to baseline methods, demonstrating faster convergence and robustness to changes in data distribution. The improvements were achieved through the implementation of adaptive prompts that allow dynamic consideration of traffic features. Additionally, the model uses data from intelligent transport systems (ITS) detectors, which ensures accurate and timely forecasting of the traffic situation. The developed approach helps to improve the efficiency of urban transport management, allowing to optimize flow regulation and minimize congestion.

articleTitle: Applications of the K-Means and Kosarayu Method for Clustering Switching Devices
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: When transmitting information over a network via communication devices, the parameters of data transmission efficiency and reliability are of paramount importance. Based on the fact that the operator does not have the ability to control traffic along its entire path from the source to the recipient, it is forced to conduct a preliminary assessment, which should take into account not only the number of senders of messages, but also the types of services that customers want to use, which ultimately leads to an increase in the load on the node. To distribute the load between network nodes, you can use their clustering using Kosarayu and k-means algorithms, each of which has its own strengths and weaknesses. The paper considers the possibility of joint application of these methods.

articleTitle: Adapting the Competencies of Specialists in the Field of Electrical Engineering, Communications and Informatization to the Requirements of Scientific and Technological Development
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The high dynamism and multifaceted nature of scientific and technological progress, especially in the field of information technology, dictate the need to form professional competencies adequate to the real requirements of the intellectual world. The article is devoted to the study of the prospects for the development of information technology, the identification of the main factors affecting the competencies of specialists in the field of electrical engineering, information communications, and the definition of a package of their modern and promising key professional competencies. Based on the analysis of the compliance of the requirements of the new technological order with the emerging competencies, conclusions were drawn about the expediency of developing system-intellectual competencies based on deeper immersion in managerial and commercial problems and the use of new tools and approaches to learning.

Author Keywords: Technological development of communications and informatization

articleTitle: The Impact of Technological Progress on the Competencies of Electronics, Radio Engineering, Communications and ICT Specialists
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The development strategy of the electronics industry and the high rates of scientific and technological progress in electronics, radio engineering, communications and ICT require the formation of new competencies of technical specialists who meet the requirements of a new technological order. The article is devoted to substantiating the need to modernize higher engineering education due to the impact of the nature of technological progress, the principles of the recent industrial revolutions, the transition to the latest generations of mobile communications, promising markets for electronic products, as well as the use of new learning tools and technologies, including the gamification method. The objectives, formats and procedures for conducting classes in the form of game situations for the implementation of promising competence indicators for electronics, radio engineering, communications and ICT specialists have been defined.

articleTitle: Educational Process Management at IT-Universities
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In modern conditions, the ability of society to develop available and synthesize new knowledge, as well as successfully apply it in practice in all areas of socio-economic and industrial activities, is of particular importance. Current knowledge is becoming not only a kind of driver for the formation of the scientific and technical potential of the state and ensuring the quality of life of the population, but also the wellbeing of society as a whole. It is higher education that plays a leading role in the realization of knowledge synthesis and the formation of a set of relevant relevant competencies among representatives of the new generation. These competencies of specialists with higher education will further determine the effectiveness of their professional activities and, consequently, the quality of processes in society. Fulfilling a special mission in the global community today is entrusted to IT specialists. The final results of the so-called digitalization of all spheres of activity depend on the level of their intellectual potential and ability to successfully perform labor functions. The achievement of relevant global goals (organizational, technological, economic, financial, social, political, etc.) is determined not only by the available conditions (favorable and unfavorable) for the implementation of a particular professional activity, but above all by the effectiveness of the management of such activities, including in the field of education.

articleTitle: Application of Linear Filtering Techniques to the Design of Rating Systems for Mobility Services
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The objective of the research is to formalize the customer service quality assessment system, which allows using digital signal processing methods in developing of the rating systems for the operator of the joint mobility market. At the moment, each company uses its own rating system for mobility services, the calculation of which is based on classical time series analysis approaches, which prevents the formation of a common accessible transport system of the city. This problem is insufficiently covered in scientific publications due to its novelty, but it is key to achieving the same level of satisfaction with services for users on each type of transport. The problem of constructing a rating system model is solved using linear digital filtering methods based on the driver's state graph, where, after fulfilling uniquely specified conditions, movement from one vertex to another occurs. The model opens the way to the formalization of the improvement applied to the rating system and determine the optimal parameters of the model. The effectiveness assessment of the new rating system confirmed its positive impact on the metric evaluating provided service quality and its high sensitivity to the change in parameters, which in turn will serve the long-term goals of creating a comfortable urban environment and reducing the negative environmental consequences from the use of individual vehicles.

articleTitle: Effective Methods of Assessing Students' Knowledge in the Field of Electrical Engineering: Traditional and Innovative Approaches
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article discusses effective methods for assessing students' knowledge in the field of electrical engineering, with an emphasis on traditional and innovative approaches. With the rapid development of technology and changing requirements for educational standards, it is important to find a balance between classical assessment methods such as exams and tests, and modern approaches, including project assignments, interactive tests and portfolios. The article analyzes the advantages and disadvantages of each method, as well as their impact on students' motivation and academic performance. Special attention is paid to the introduction of digital technologies into the assessment process, which allows for a more accurate reflection of the level of knowledge and skills of students. The results of the study can be useful for both teachers and educational institutions seeking to improve the quality of education in the field of electrical engineering.

articleTitle: Survey of LLMs and AI Agents in V2X: Simulation, Analysis & Architectures
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In this paper, a comprehensive survey of the integration of large language models (LLMs) and AI agents in (Vehicle-to-Everything) V2X systems is presented. Their application in simulation, analysis, and architectural design is examined, highlighting the enhancement of realistic scenario generation, adaptive data processing, and real-time decision-making. Interdisciplinary perspectives, including cloud computing and data engineering, are explored to demonstrate scalable simulation frameworks and efficient analytics. Comparative analyses of existing platforms illustrate significant improvements in safety, efficiency, and reliability in modern transportation networks. Emerging trends and future research directions, such as scalable deployment, privacy preservation, and standardization, are discussed. The findings underscore the transformative potential of integrating AI technologies in V2X infrastructures, paving the way for smarter, safer, and more resilient transportation systems. These advances offer promising avenues for further innovation in mobility.

articleTitle: Joint Optimization of Reconfigurable Intelligent Surface Phase Shifts and Power Allocation in LEO-NOMA Systems Using Soft Actor-Critic
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Combining Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces (RIS) with Non-Orthogonal Multiple Access (NOMA) offers a promising way to improve spectral efficiency and energy utilization in Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite networks. However, the highly dynamic nature of LEO environments make it challenging to optimize RIS phase shifts and power allocation in real time. This paper introduces a reinforcement learning-based framework that applies the Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) algorithm to jointly optimize RIS configurations and power allocation among users. The proposed method works in two stages: first, SAC fine-tunes RIS phase shifts while keeping power allocation fixed; then, it dynamically adjusts power levels to enhance overall system performance. This method, in contrast to traditional strategies that depend on perfect channel state information (CSI), focuses on adaptive decision-making aimed at maximizing rewards, effectively mitigating the impact of channel estimation errors during training. Simulation results confirm that the SAC-based framework effectively boosts channel capacity without requiring additional transmission power. Furthermore, integrating RIS with NOMA further enhances performance, making it a strong candidate for next-generation satellite communications.

articleTitle: Refinement of the Two-Fluid Model Application for Energy Consumption Assessment and Traffic Flow Analysis in Urban Transport
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This study analyzes energy consumption in an urban transport network using TFM and VECE models. The study is based on real vehicle traffic data collected using detectors and Yandex.Maps, as well as on modeling macroscopic energy consumption. As a result of calculations, it was found that with an increase in the sensitivity parameter of the quality of road service (n) by 72%, the total energy consumption decreases compared to the minimum values of this parameter. The effect of flow density is also confirmed: an increase in density by 10% leads to an increase in energy consumption by 15%. Comparison of real and predicted data showed that Yandex.Maps forecasts can deviate from actual measurements by 6-7%. Two Fluid Model (TFM) and Vehicle Energy Conservation Equation (VECE) models allow you to effectively estimate energy consumption in the road network and optimize traffic flows to reduce emissions and energy costs, which is important for the development of sustainable transport systems.

articleTitle: Classroom Technologies in Modern Higher Education Transformation of the Teacher's Place and Role
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article examines the transformation of the teacher's place, role, and functions under the influence of modern pedagogical innovations and cultural and socio-economic processes. Shifts in public expectations regarding higher education, advancements in learning methodologies, and evolving economic and technological environments highlight the importance and significance of a teacher's role within the higher education landscape. The first part of the article explores the technological and socio-cultural processes affecting the modern university. The second part analyzes transformations in the academic profession and pedagogical methods, tools, and formats used in the learning process. Based on the study of the most in-demand teaching practices and educational technologies, the article concludes that there is a significant trend toward changing the fundamental role and significance of the teacher in higher education in the era of neo-struction.

articleTitle: Simulation of the Functioning of Self-Adjusting Systems with Additive and Parametric Feedback
publicationTitle: 2025 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: For processes implemented in various control systems, it is often necessary to ensure the presence of selfadaptation (self-learning) properties, in particular, this is important when the control object is characterized by a wide range of transmission coefficient changes, as well as if it is necessary to ensure the stability of the quality of the object's control processes when exposed to a set of parametric disturbances. The successful operation of control systems in such conditions must be ensured so that the system's response to this signal is adequate and effectively formed in accordance with the quality criterion, for example, the minimum error. One of the ways to solve such problems is to integrate additive parametric feedback circuits into the control system. At the same time, it is necessary to ensure that the condition regarding the independence of the error value from the values of the object parameters is fulfilled. This, in turn, ensures that errors are minimized. The authors of this scientific study have developed and substantiated a way to ensure such a condition for minimizing control errors by forming a parametric feedback subsystem. Other means are also proposed and justified to minimize errors in the management of systems and processes of various types.
